title: ID0396334/Si-D/DK-4-D[MP / SN 170004220]-Customer got free charging
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:  Customer seems to start charging with creditcard but as soon as he plugs in the car it also starts on autocharge. The charging starts but then the autocharge stops the transaction and we send that the session cost is 0 DKK but charging session keeps going and the customer ends up charging for free.
See timestamps between  2024-12-18T09:25 >2024-12-18T09:50. This is on connector 2.
Root cause:
Possible
ncorrect processing of the Seitatech payment terminal message towards the OCPP Backend. within  FW v4.0.11
Solution: FW Updated
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: Active
2024.01.21: Handover from ES to NOC

additional_info.subject: 0396334 - ID039633C/Si-D/DK-4-D[MP / SN 170004220]-Customer got free charging CRM:00314000136
additional_info.body:
Good evening Magnus,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0396334.
The ticket was opened for an event of free charging session with  FW
v4.0.11-0-g0b7d164+SF-RETOPICS
.
As per the analysis, it seems that from Seitatech we have an undefined command to abort the transaction with payload, and an error on the preauthorize.
Just after this, the charger sends an OCPP command to Stop the session, and the response is empty.
The charging session on DC2 starts at 2024-12-18T09:26:55, and it finishes only at 2024-12-18T09:49:44 from vehicle side, with no other OCPP message. It looks to me as this issue might be related to an incorrect processing of the Seitatech payment terminal message towards the OCPP Backend.
My question is:
has this behavior happened again with FW6.0.3
? IF this event happened only in this occasion and on v4.0.11, it might be the case that no further investigation is required.
I am looking forward to hearing your feedback and opinion soon. Please reach out to me if you have more information or if you want to discuss the topic further.
With kind regards,

additional_info.subject: Handover from ES to NOC
additional_info.body:
Problem Description
:
undefined command to abort the transaction with payload from Seitatech, and an error on the preauthorize, caused charging session not to stop and without billing
Suspected Root Cause
: Possible
ncorrect processing of the Seitatech payment terminal message towards the OCPP Backend. within  FW v4.0.11
Action Performed (ES)
: Logs analysis
Charger SW Version
: v6.0.3
Reason for Handover (ES/NOC
): Charger has been updated to v6.0.3 and since then issue did not appear again. Issue appeared only once with v4.0.11. Ticket can be closed as no further investigation will be conducted on an issue related ot v4.0.11. If issue will appear on v6.03, a new ticket will be opened.
